newsitem.title: GERMANY: E-Plus sees sales doubling in 1997.
newsitem.headline: E-Plus sees sales doubling in 1997.

text.p: German mobile communications company E-Plus Mobilfunk GmbH said on Thursday it hoped to double its turnover this year from about 500 million marks ($295 million) in 1996.
"Start-up losses last year were in line with expectations, and they will remain within projected levels in 1997," said E-Plus managing director Herbert Brenke at the Cebit technology fair.
E-Plus invested one billion marks last year, Brenke said. Investment plans for this year are still in line with the projected total of four billion marks since the company's start four years ago.
E-Plus is owned by Veba AG, Thyssen AG, BellSouth Corp and Vodafone of the U.K.
